description: This file defines the 'PersonalizeRuntimeClient' class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods to interact with the Amazon Personalize Runtime service, including fetching recommendations and personalized rankings asynchronously and synchronously.

classes.name: PersonalizeRuntimeClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Personalize Runtime service, extending the base AWS client.

methods.name: getActionRecommendations
methods.description: Retrieves action-based recommendations for a user.

methods.name: getPersonalizedRanking
methods.description: Retrieves a personalized ranking for a user.
